en.headline: HK Phil opens new music director era with Mahler Symphony No. 8
en.dek: Tarmo Peltokoski conducts the orchestra’s first performance of the Symphony of a Thousand at the Cultural Centre this weekend, with multiple choirs and soloists.
body: The Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra opens the tenure of its new music director Tarmo Peltokoski this weekend with performances of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 8 at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Concert Hall.

The concerts take place on Saturday 7 November at 5pm and Sunday 8 November at 3pm. The Hong Kong Philharmonic said the work marks the orchestra’s premiere of the symphony and completes its cycle of all Mahler’s symphonies. The programme runs for approximately one hour and forty minutes without an intermission.

Soloists include Jacquelyn Wagner, Chen Reiss, Louise Kwong, Catriona Morison, Sasha Cooke, Tuomas Katajala, Rinalds Kandalincevs and Shenyang. Combined choirs feature the Hong Kong Philharmonic Chorus, the London Philharmonic Choir, The Hong Kong Children’s Choir and The Learners Chorus, among others. The performances form part of the 6th Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Culture and Arts Festival.

Ticket prices range from HK$680 to HK$2,080 and are available through URBTIX. The orchestra has said each patron may purchase up to four tickets per transaction. The concert is suitable for ages six and above.

zh.headline: 港樂新音樂總監以馬勒第八交響曲揭幕
zh.dek: 貝托祺本周末於文化中心指揮樂團首演《千人交響曲》，聯同多支合唱團及聲樂家演出。
body: 香港管弦樂團本周末以馬勒第八交響曲為新任音樂總監貝托祺揭幕，於香港文化中心音樂廳舉行兩場演出。
音樂會分別於11月7日星期六下午5時及11月8日星期日下午3時舉行。港樂表示，是次為樂團首演該交響曲，並完成演奏全部馬勒交響曲的周期。演出約1小時40分鐘，不設中場休息。
聲樂家包括Jacquelyn Wagner、陳蕾絲、鄧樂之、Catriona Morison、Sasha Cooke、Tuomas Katajala、Rinalds Kandalincevs及沈洋。合唱團陣容包括香港管弦樂團合唱團、倫敦愛樂合唱團、香港兒童合唱團及學員合唱團等。音樂會屬第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節節目之一。
門票售價由680元至2,080元，透過城市售票網發售。港樂指每人每次限購四張。適合六歲或以上人士。
